name: Aloo Tikki Recipe, How to Make Aloo Tikki | Aloo Cutlet | Potato Patties
ingredients:
300 grams potatoes (OR 3 medium sized potatoes)
½ teaspoon kashmiri red chilli powder (OR 1 to 2 green chilies, finely chopped)
½ teaspoon coriander powder ((dhania powder))
½ teaspoon cumin powder ((jeera powder))
¼ teaspoon dry ginger powder ((saunth powder) or ½ tsp minced ginger)
¼ teaspoon chaat masala powder
1.5 to 2 tablespoon corn flour ((corn starch) or rice flour or arrowroot flour, add as required) - or plain flour
2 to 3 teaspoons chopped coriander leaves
2 tablespoons oil (for frying the tikkis or as required)
salt (as required)
directions:
preparation for aloo tikki

• boil the potatoes till they are falling apart

• mash the potatoes

• add the spice powders, salt, plain flour and coriander leaves.

• With your hands, form balls from the potato mix, each weighing around 45g. Flatten the balls a little, so they look like patties, put on a plate and refrigerate for 20 minutes to firm up. you can apply some oil on your palms when making the patties or tikkis.

making aloo tikki

• heat oil till its medium hot in a tava or a shallow frying pan. gently place the aloo tikki and pan fry them.

• when one side of tikki becomes golden and crisp, turn over and fry the other side of tikki, gently flip for a couple of times till the aloo tikki are golden and crisp evenly.

• once done, then drain the aloo tikki on paper towels to remove excess oil.
